text:
A Stanley Cup ring from Florida came with Mackie Samoskevich to Seattle, and his first 18 games as a Kraken have gone well: 6 goals and 13 points at about 15 and a half minutes a night, with 9 of those points in his last ten games.

Not all of it will hold. He has 6 goals on 3.5 expected goals (the quality of his chances), shooting 18.8% against a league norm of 13.4%, and his teammates have scored 4.7 more goals than expected with him on the ice. Our talent range has his true scoring rate around 2.0 points per 60, below the 2.78 he's posting.

The game underneath is real, though. Evolving-Hockey had his play-driving impact in the 90th percentile of forwards last season, and he draws more penalties than he takes. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 70% of his exits leaving with possession and 53% of his shots coming off the rush. Watch him in the first seconds after Seattle wins the puck back: that's where his offense lives.
